subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the scene master reference of the location.
<Picture 2> is the character reference sheet of Lin Zhixia (eighteen-year-old girl, low ponytail, mist-blue worn T-shirt, off-white home trousers, frayed crimson cord on her left wrist).
<Picture 1> to <Picture 2> are the only references; the repeating ones repeat the SAME rooms and the SAME people and add no new characters.
<Subject 1> is the scene master reference of the apartment interior, as shown in <Picture 1>:
<Subject 2> is Lin Zhixia, an eighteen-year-old Chinese girl: thin with narrow shoulders, neck tilted forward about five degrees, black hair in a low ponytail, thick untrimmed eyebrows, a faint blue-grey tint beneath her eyes, washed-out mist-blue cotton T-shirt, and a frayed crimson cord on her left wrist:

summary:
reference generation. A thirteen-second sequence in which the girl's face registers what she has just read, then the refrigerator door opens and the cold light falls on her while two dated containers sit on the upper shelf.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the same face, ponytail, eyebrows, under-eye tint, mist-blue T-shirt and crimson wrist co rd; her posture sta (<Subject 1>)ys upright and small.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the refrigerator body, its inner light, the left-wall stove and the corridor lamp keep their positions and their colour temperature.
the object (appears in [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - two containers, semi-transparent walls, beige tape strips and the handwritten dates are carried from the prop reference.

detailed_description:
Photographic realism with even visible film grain, a single-source discipline in which the refrigerator's inner light becomes the only lamp of the second shot, a light ratio near one to five, deep shadows that keep texture, 50–85mm lenses, and warm yellow giving way to cold white for exactly one beat.
Time of day: night. The only light is one warm tungsten source inside the room, roughly twenty-seven hundred to three thousand kelvin, falling from a single direction; the rest of the frame sinks into shadow with a light ratio of about one to five; wet-night reflections outside the windows. [Shot 1] Lin Zhixia's face fills the left of the frame in an 85mm close shot in profile at eye level, locked off; she does not blink, her gaze resting on the booklet off screen, and her eyelashes cast a small shadow under the lamp. Her jaw line tightens once, her throat rolls in a single swallow, and she presses the movement flat again. Warm light from the right keeps her left cheek in shadow while a single small highlight sits in her eye. (<Subject 2>)
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to a medium shot, 50mm, forty-five-degree side angle at eye level, locked off. The refrigerator door swings open and its cold inner light climbs across her face, the only cold-lit frontal moment in the whole film. She stands inside that light with one hand resting on the door and does not reach for anything yet; the area behind her back falls to black, and the cold white of the interior contrasts with the warm corridor beyond the doorway. The seal of the door releases with a soft suck, and the compressor hums low.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, the camera cuts to an 85mm close shot of the objects, forty-five-degree side angle with a slight high angle, locked off. Two clear containers sit on the upper shelf, each only half eaten, each lid taped down; the tape strips carry handwritten dates that read "6/21" and "6/24". The cold light presses down from above so that the lids catch the light, the bases drop into shadow, and the two containers stand apart with a stretch of empty shelf between them.

continuity_anchors: the room must match <Picture 1> exactly - the same room layout, the same furniture positions, the same wall and floor materials, the same single warm lamp and the same light direction, the same refrigerator, the same dining table with its four wooden chairs. Do not redesign, relocate or invent any part of the space. Props stay exactly as described and as seen in <Picture 1>: the dining table carries exactly three bowls and three pairs of chopsticks (the innermost pair set straighter); the off-white trousers and the mist-blue pilled T-shirt on the girl must not change colour, fabric or cut; the mother's apron and white sleeve covers must not change.
hard_negatives: no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen typography, no watermarks, no logos, no timecodes, no text overlays of any kind; the image must stay free of rendered text unless the text is a physical object inside the scene explicitly described above (a phone screen or a printed document). No extra people, no duplicated characters, no split screen, no frame borders.

overall_soundscape:
A breath pressed down and held, the light snap of a corridor motion-sensor lamp switching on, the soft suck of a refrigerator seal, a low compressor hum, and a thin current buzz from the interior lamp.

non_diegetic_music:
Silence; the segment carries diegetic sound only, and score is added later in post-production.
